explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because percent-formatting embeds y_ts, inverter_serial, etoday, and etotal directly into the SQLite INSERT query. Crafted input in inverter_serial or numeric fields could alter the SQL statement and corrupt stored data. The repair replaces formatted placeholders with '?' and binds (y_ts, inverter_serial, etoday, etotal) as a tuple in self.c.execute().
